text:
tara: Hi @people-ops 1 I need to request a short-term private-office accommodation after a strong-scent incident yesterday triggered a panic response and migraines. Doctor suggests a private, low-scent workspace + flexible meeting hours for ~4 weeks. I can DM the note.

mohit: Thanks for flagging, Tara. Please DM the medical note to me or @ana. Well open an intake and handle communication narrowly. Can you share the preferred start date and any on-site days you must be present?

tara: DMd the note. Prefer start 2026-05-04. I usually come Tues/Thurs for focused work; would like those to be in a private room and avoid open-desk seating near the 4th floor pantry.

people-ops-bot: Intake created  ID #4989  status: awaiting manager acknowledgement.

ana: Acknowledged intake #4989. Tara, Ill coordinate with Facilities for a private room and confirm with your manager about meeting adjustments. This is an accommodation request, not related to performance.

sam-facilities: Hi @ana @tara  Facilities can assign a temporary private room (small desk + sound-damp panel). We can also post a scent-free reminder in the immediate area. ETA for room prep: 48 hours after approval. Any preferences for room location?

tara: A quiet north-facing room would be great. Also, I have an onsite interview panel Friday 5/07 that I was scheduled to run. Id like to stay involved remotely and hand off any physical tasks to Mohit. Can we avoid having my health details on interview notes?

mohit: I can cover the onsite tasks for the 5/07 panel. Tara, please add a short async checklist in the candidate doc with debrief prompts. Well keep the accommodation private to the recruiter and backup interviewer.

ana: Confirming: 1) Manager acknowledgement recorded, 2) Facilities to reserve private room, 3) Interview coverage assigned to Mohit, 4) 1-week check-in scheduled. Well set privacy flags in the HR system.

tara: Thank you. Also request: on quiet-office days could we move daily standup 30 min later? Morning light/noise intensifies symptoms.

mohit: Thats fine. Ill propose a temporary 10:00 standup for Taras quiet days and communicate to the team.

people-ops-bot: Intake #4989 updated  status: facilities scheduled. Room prep set for 2026-05-05 09:00.

sam-facilities: Room assigned: North Annex 3B. Air purifier and low-light screen installed. Move-in available 2026-05-05 after 9:30.

ana: Thanks @sam-facilities. Tara, check-in scheduled for 2026-05-12 to review whether adjustments are sufficient. If you need more support (schedule shifts, extended remote), escalate to me directly.

tara: Really appreciate the quick response and privacy. Ill drop the async interview checklist now and confirm move-in on 5/05.

mohit: Noted. Will cover the onsite responsibilities on 5/07. :thumbsup:

ana: Closing note: this is documented as a private accommodation; performance expectations unchanged. Documented actions will not be shared beyond those who need to know.

tara: Thank you all  felt very supported.
